arguments.name: environment
arguments.description: Environment whose OpenShift login session (<session>/.kube/<environment>/config) is used.

arguments.name: services
arguments.description: Ordered, non-empty list of unique deployment names to restart.

arguments.name: service_readiness
arguments.description: How restarted services are judged ready: ready_by ('ready' or 'log', default 'ready'), success_messages, failure_messages, timeout (default 300) and poll_interval (default 5) in seconds.

arguments.name: rebuild
arguments.description: Run a cache rebuild (true) or a plain restart of the services (false).

arguments.name: cache
arguments.description: Cache rebuild settings, required when rebuild is true: deployment (one of services), environment {name, value} set during the rebuild, and readiness (same keys as service_readiness).

arguments.name: stop_all_before_cache_rebuild
arguments.description: When rebuilding, stop every service before the cache deployment is rebuilt.

arguments.name: parallel
arguments.description: Restart the remaining services in parallel.

outputs.name: rebuild
outputs.description: Whether a cache rebuild was performed.
